## anu-p02 — argument map

Saṃsāra is not, in truth (tattvatas), for body-holders (tanubhṛtām). Of bondage, what news (vārtā)? If bondage never truly is anyone's (bandho yasya na jātu), the liberation-rite (muktikriyā) is false (vitathā) for the free. Diagnosis: an error-maker (mithyāmohakṛt), a heap of four delusions — rope, snake, shadow, ghost. Rule: abandon nothing (mā kiṃcit tyaja), grasp nothing (mā gṛhāṇa); live (vihara) healthy (svasthaḥ), staying (yathāvasthitaḥ).

### Open
- Whether 'muktasya muktikriyā' means 'liberation-rite for the free' or 'rite of the liberated' is unresolved.
- Whether 'vihara' is imperative or indicative is unresolved.
